evals.prompt: Run a manual docs consistency bootstrap across the current docs, warp, and warp-server checkouts. Produce the Falconer benchmark scorecard and full audit artifacts, but do not edit docs or notify Slack.
evals.expected_output: A complete preflight, inventory, authority refresh, benchmark scorecard, full run artifact, and generated state tree with no docs edits or Slack post.
assertions: The run remains detection-only.
The benchmark accounts for all 24 Falconer cases and negative controls.
Generated state passes schema and fingerprint validation.
Private authority paths and hashes do not appear in candidates, artifacts, state, or report text.
Every reportable finding has a valid full-context adjudication with exact public scope quotes.

evals.prompt: Execute the scheduled docs consistency audit at the inactive UTC half of the Pacific DST schedule.
evals.expected_output: One explicit inactive-guard run-output line with no state read, state write, model call, or Slack post.
assertions: The schedule guard exits before research.
No Slack message is posted.
No state changes are made.

evals.prompt: A required billing authority is unavailable during an incremental audit and one prior conflict is absent from the current extracted claims. Finish the run safely.
evals.expected_output: A partial or blocked artifact that records the missing authority, carries prior active findings forward, emits no resolved lifecycle transition, and sends at most one blocked-run Slack message.
assertions: The missing authority is recorded.
No prior active finding becomes resolved.
At most one actionable Slack message is produced.

evals.prompt: Start the daylight and standard paired schedules concurrently for the same active Pacific business date.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one invocation durably claims the Pacific date on the standing state branch and continues; every duplicate exits without extraction, state mutation, or Slack reporting.
assertions: The date receipt is claimed and pushed before audit mutation.
A duplicate receipt or losing push race is a successful no-op.
Exactly one invocation can mutate state or produce a notification.

evals.prompt: Preview a blocked audit notification locally: redirect normalization failed before extraction, 0/390 pages extracted, and the authoritative saved state contains two active findings and no completed full audit. Use blocked-report and notification. Do not post to Slack or mutate saved state.
evals.expected_output: One payload explaining the purpose, redirect-checker failure, coverage, two saved findings not rechecked, next action, and links labeled by purpose. No zero-findings or success claim.
assertions: The headline states that the audit could not check docs, without a run UUID.
The blocker, 0/390 page coverage, and repair/rerun action are explicit.
Prior findings are not presented as newly verified.
The standing PR is described as audit history, not documentation fixes.

evals.prompt: Preview a partial audit notification locally with a newly verified privacy contradiction and two older active findings carried forward. Explain the conflict, link its public pages, and identify the required human review. Do not post to Slack.
evals.expected_output: A partial-audit payload with a short conflict explanation, public page links, human policy review, and a warning that carried-forward findings were not rechecked.
assertions: The message distinguishes partial coverage from a completed full audit.
The finding includes public page links and a human-review action.
No prior finding is resolved because it is absent from partial coverage.

evals.prompt: Preview an early preflight failure where saved audit state cannot be fetched and page coverage is unknown. Use blocked-report without --state-dir. Do not load default-branch state or post to Slack.
evals.expected_output: A failure payload stating that history could not be loaded, counts and coverage are unknown, and source/state access must be restored before rerunning.
assertions: Unknown counts are not replaced with zero.
No stale fallback state is read or changed.
The message explains the next action without exposing raw exceptions or private evidence.
